description: This header file defines the exported API functions for the TLS Hso Server Object, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions. It serves as an interface for the TLS Hso Server component within the broader Transport Layer Security implementation.

methods.name: TlsCreateHsoServer
methods.description: Factory function to create an instance of the Hso Server object.

methods.name: TlsHsoServerCreate
methods.description: Creates a new Hso Server object with provided context handles.

methods.name: TlsHsoServerRemove
methods.description: Removes/deletes an existing Hso Server object.

methods.name: TlsHsoServerEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects within the Hso Server instance.

methods.name: TlsHsoServerInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Hso Server object to a ready state.
